user.title: Sign in to Mijn ENGIE
user.description: Unofficial: uses the same sign-in and data as the Mijn ENGIE website. The password is stored encrypted. If ENGIE emails you a code, you'll enter it in the next step.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Mijn ENGIE again
reauth_confirm.description: The Mijn ENGIE session for {username} has ended. Submit to sign in again (ENGIE may email you a new code). Leave the password empty to use the stored one.

code.title: Code from ENGIE
code.description: ENGIE has emailed you a sign-in code. Enter it here.

error.invalid_auth: ENGIE refused the username or password.
error.mfa_required: This account asks for a second sign-in step, which the integration doesn't support.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Mijn ENGIE or it answered unexpectedly. See the log.
error.invalid_code: ENGIE didn't accept the code. Check it (or wait for the newest email) and try again.
error.no_session: ENGIE accepted the sign-in, but Mijn ENGIE didn't start a session. Details are in the log.

abort.already_configured: This ENGIE account is already set up.
